method: Redirect-following HTTP/1.1 GET of every primary link in the Language and General narrative editions. 20-second timeout. 12 MB size cap; an HTTP 200 size-cap stop is distinct from a dead link. Identity evidence and alternative destinations from the 22 October audit retained. Access restrictions are not classified as dead links.

resolution.accessLimits: Some publisher URLs return access restrictions, bot challenges or timeouts to automated requests. These are recorded separately from missing pages. McKinsey replacements and the GSMA 2018 report were independently identified in primary publisher web results despite request restrictions. Full-text availability is not guaranteed.
